build_method: Official releng profile, project overlay, iterative mkarchiso rebuilds inside a disposable Arch VM

boot.machine: q35 / TCG / cpu max / 2 vCPUs / 6 GiB RAM
boot.target: Separate empty 20 GiB qcow2, serial EASYARCH-ISO-FINAL

scope: Live boot/autostart/hardware/catalog smoke check only. Full installation cases ran separately through the actual backend; the GUI/helper capacity fault used the earlier live image with session/mode corrections in RAM.
artifact_note: Generated ISO is excluded from Git; local artifact and SHA256SUMS are in iso/out. The package/version manifest is committed separately. Iterative image retained official core/extra sync DBs, preferred by Catalog over the bundled core/extra/multilib snapshot.
